name: SimplyBook.me
summary: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses — booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments.
best_for: service businesses that take appointments and want a booking page, reminders and online payment without building one
skip_if: you only need a simple calendar link for one person — a free scheduling link does that without a booking system on top
honest_knock: The plan ladder is set by bookings per month and by how many custom features you may switch on, and those two ceilings move independently — so you can outgrow a plan on features while nowhere near the booking cap, or the reverse. Free and Basic also carry SimplyBook.me branding on your booking page; white-label starts at Premium. Two integration limits sit in their own documentation. Calendar Sync works with web calendars only, and the help page warns it may not work with Microsoft Exchange calendars. The Zapier connector, which gained a create-booking action in June 2026, stops working once HIPAA or Google Authenticator is switched on — so the practices most likely to need HIPAA lose the Zapier route.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-16 and again 2026-10-20 on simplybook.me/en/pricing, EUR, priceCurrency 'EUR' in the page's own markup) Free plan, EUR 0 a month: 50 bookings a month, 1 custom feature, 1 provider, no card needed. Basic EUR 11.9 a month billed annually or EUR 13.9 monthly: 100 bookings, 3 custom features, 5 providers. Standard EUR 24.9 billed annually or EUR 29.9 monthly: 500 bookings, 8 custom features, 15 providers. Premium EUR 49.9 billed annually or EUR 59.9 monthly: 2,000 bookings, unlimited custom features, 30 providers. Enterprise is custom-priced after a call. Annual billing saves a stated 17%. Their own page says no setup fees, no transaction fees and no per-user charges; payment processors bill their own rates separately. A 14-day trial of premium features runs without a card. Add-ons are priced in dollars on the same page: 100 SMS credits $8, 100 extra bookings $4, a custom domain with three years of SSL $119. Currency note: on 2026-09-20 the same page served the ladder in Brazilian reais to two European networks; on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-20 it was in euros, while a second reading on 2026-10-20 from another connection showed the same figures with dollar signs, so check the currency on the card before you compare.
